result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast problem: white headline and body text sit on a very pale mint-green background, making the offer nearly illegible. A couple of minor cosmetic inconsistencies were also noted in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the headline and the supporting line ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are rendered in white on a very light mint-green background. The contrast ratio is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer text is barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green/near-black) on the light banner, or darken/saturate the banner background so white text achieves at least 4.5:1 contrast (3:1 for large headline text).

issues.description: The subtext in the promo banner is even lower contrast than the headline because it is smaller, lighter-weight white text on the same pale background, compounding the readability problem.
issues.suggestion: Apply a secondary dark color with sufficient contrast for the small supporting text, and consider slightly increasing its weight/size.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel thumbnails are visually inconsistent: the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light gray/white background while the other cards use dark blurred backgrounds, making the row look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card image treatment (consistent background tone, blur, or overlay) so all thumbnails share the same visual style.
